purpose: Turn a researched protocol and governance landscape into a sequenced, claim-disciplined private publication program without converting open hypotheses into results.
audience: Researchers in scholarly communication, network science, research integrity, sociotechnical systems, and scientific workflow provenance.
section_type: multi-paper structural outlines and evidence plan
outline: Map the fragmented prior literatures and define the consolidated object
State root-relative trust as a scoped reliance view rather than a personal scalar
Derive formal questions and comparison arms without claiming results
Specify protocol objects and a bounded reference implementation
Evaluate conformance and adversarial properties before field effectiveness
Gate independent-actor pilots on ethics, privacy, power, and preregistration
Defer a software paper until release and use evidence exists
figures_tables: Paper 02 phase/capture diagrams, contingent on executed analysis
Paper 03 conformance matrix and attack comparisons, contingent on artifacts
Paper 04 participant flow and adverse-event accounting, contingent on ethics approval
human_questions: Which human authors accept responsibility for each paper?
Should the design map or the formal result lead the submission sequence after evidence gates?
Which exact venue and article type has a confirmed no-fee or RIT-covered route at submission time?
What ethics/IRB determination and independent governance are required before any pilot?
constraints: Private-not-approved: no submission, preprint, public release, or external contact.
Use only public literature, synthetic fixtures, and non-sensitive inherited packets.
Separate observation, inference, implication, caveat, transition, design choice, and open hypothesis.
Primary-source identity and claim-support verification remain required before publishable prose.
The persistent science-writer gateway run timed out; this packet was created by directly applying the shared scientific-writing skill.
excluded_claims: Do not claim invention of decentralized review, graph trust, topic reputation, anonymous credentials, provenance, or append-only logs.
Do not claim that local trust improves scientific correctness, fairness, privacy, or capture resistance before results exist.
Do not claim that the v0.1 prototype provides signatures, Sybil resistance, unlinkability, appeals, governance legitimacy, or field validation.
Do not draft a JOSS paper from a repository skeleton.
retrieval_capability: Existing bounded research packet available; new primary-source and venue-policy verification is pending.
